d: Darya is making the big move from San Francisco to Nashville, to live next door to her best friend and cousin, Michael.
In this episode we get more Renovate or Rebuild inspiration and the winning team give back to a devestaed community. We also see the losing team's ultimate punishment.

st: House 1: A Mid Century Modern Dilemma
d: Lisa owns an old Queenslander in inner city Brisbane, the home is tired and needs updating. Lisa is eclectic and loves Mid century design. Jimmy and Tam are on the case to help Lisa on her journey to decide whether she should Renovate or Rebuild to create her dream home.

st: House 1 A Build: A Mid Century Modern Masterpiece
d: Lisa made the big decision to Renovate her old Queenslander into a Mid Century modern masterpiece. We follow the entire build to see if this dream becomes a reality.

After her home is set on fire, Chili is pressured to hire a contractor who doesn't understand how to make it right. With nowhere else to turn she contacts the one person who does: Mike Holmes, and he's determined to make her home safe.

Peggy and Don need Mike's help. They paid a contractor to build them a second story addition and he took off to Europe, leaving their home exposed to heavy rains. Their basement is destroyed, their belongings are ruined and Mike uncovers the biggest nest of carpenter ants he's ever seen.

Chili's home was completely damaged at the hands of an arsonist. In order to understand what Chili faced that fateful night and what her home needs to make it safe, Mike puts on his firefighter boots and steps into the fire himself.
